text:
Nora Patel: Hiring manager for Senior Product (candidate: Alex Rivera) requesting an exception: provisional band bump M6 -> M7 for 6 months, $12k sign-on, and front-loaded RSU grant. Need routing; candidate has 48h to decide.
Diego Ruiz: Why provisional vs permanent? any calibration notes?
Nora Patel: Manager notes candidate led multiple product launches at scale; current org banding conservative. They want provisional M7 to onboard quickly and calibrate after 6 months.
Priya Kapoor: Routing checklist:
- provisional band form (M6->M7, 6mo review)
- sign-on approval $12k
- RSU front-load approval + vesting schedule
- payroll + tax treatment
- offer letter language + clawback
hr-ops-bot: Request 3725556667 logged. Approvals required: Comp Committee, Legal Team, Payroll Ops. Deadline: 48h.
Comp Committee: $12k sign-on > our $10k soft cap. Need manager justification and market comps. Also want to confirm temporary uplift policy.
Nora Patel: Uploaded manager justification and external comps (3 comp data points). Manager suggests 6-month provisional period with review and potential re-band.
Comp Committee: Provisionally approve M7 for 6 months and $12k sign-on pending Legal & Payroll. Vote: majority.
Legal Team: Sign-on > $10k triggers enhanced clawback language; also need RSU front-load contract terms. Drafting clauses.
Payroll Ops: One-time sign-on payout okay; RSU front-load requires equity ops coordination. Need cost center and exact payment timing to advise tax withholding.
Priya Kapoor: Manager provided cost_center=ENG-PD and invoice_code=PD-7733. Proposed start date 2026-08-03; candidate can start earlier if we finalize today.
hr-ops-bot: Approval update: Comp Committee=approved, Legal Team=pending, Payroll Ops=pending.
Diego Ruiz: For RSU front-load, what's the proposal? full first-year grant upfront or accelerated vesting?
Nora Patel: Manager requests 50% of first-year RSU grant upfront (front-load) with vesting schedule 25% at 3 months, 25% at 6 months, remainder per standard schedule. Wants this as a retention signal.
Legal Team: Concern: accelerated 3-month cliff is nonstandard. We'll approve with clawback: full repay if leaving within 3 months, 50% repay if leaving before 12 months. Drafting amendment.
Payroll Ops: Tax implication significant if front-loaded. Need gross-up decision? Also equity ops needs grant approval ticket to set nonstandard vesting. Equity Ops + Payroll must coordinate.
Priya Kapoor: Escalating to Equity Ops and EVP People for gross-up and vesting exception. Adding details to the request.
hr-ops-bot: Added approver: Equity Ops. Deadline remains 48h.
Equity Ops (via message): Can implement nonstandard vesting if Legal approves, but must be recorded in grant ticket. Need exact grant amount and RSU type (standard RSU, not performance units).
Priya Kapoor: Confirming RSU type = standard RSU; first-year grant amount = 12,000 RSU-notional (manager provided USD notional). Will share exact share count after comp is finalized.
Legal Team: Draft complete. Clawback covers sign-on and front-loaded RSUs. Recommending 100% repay if departure within 90 days; graded thereafter.
Payroll Ops: With cost center and invoice code, we can process sign-on on next payroll. For RSU tax withholding we need to coordinate with Equity Ops. Recommend candidate receives tax guidance note in offer.
hr-ops-bot: Approval update: Comp Committee=approved, Legal Team=approved, Equity Ops=pending, Payroll Ops=pending.
Priya Kapoor: Equity Ops please review and confirm grant ticket timeline. Also, @Nora please confirm if company will gross-up tax on RSU or sign-on.
Nora Patel: Manager confirms no gross-up on RSU. For sign-on, manager requests gross-up to net candidate ~10k but budget constrained. Willing to do no gross-up and mention tax estimate in offer.
Equity Ops: Can schedule grant ticket once Legal finalizes language. Need signed offer to start grant creation process; lead time ~5 business days.
Payroll Ops: Final note: to hit proposed start 2026-08-03 and process sign-on in first payroll, we need signed offer by EOD today and all fields in Workday: job_band=M7_provisional, signon=12000, rsu_frontload=50pct_first_year, cost_center=ENG-PD, invoice_code=PD-7733.
Priya Kapoor: Drafting final offer now with provisional band M7 (6-month review), $12k sign-on, RSU front-load terms, and Legal-approved clawback. Candidate acceptance window 48h. Sending momentarily.
Nora Patel: Thank you. I'll coord with manager to confirm earlier start logistics if candidate signs. Onboarding and eng-ops notified for kit prep.
hr-ops-bot: Thread will close on offer acceptance or 48h timeout. Notifications sent to approvers.
